QUANTUM GUARD 1.9.0
Integrated cloud-management and updater preview

WHAT CHANGED
This package continues from the uploaded Quantum Guard 1.8.0 updater preview and integrates the cloud/device requirements discussed for Quantum Guard.

Implemented in the Windows client:
* Google/Supabase cloud session support using the existing PKCE login flow.
* Roaming profile context plus device-specific owner/admin/client role resolution.
* Managed Client UI restrictions so a client does not receive administrator controls simply by signing in.
* Device heartbeat every 60 seconds with app version, hostname, Windows user and device state.
* Device-specific policy polling and application.
* Remote command polling for policy refresh, app update, account status, device state, Windows sign-out and app lock commands.
* Dedicated pairing-code display with a 15-minute expiry state.
* Cloud status repainting intended to prevent old transparent Win32 status text from remaining underneath newer messages.
* Built-in GitHub update checks, background downloads, SHA-256 verification, update handoff and first-start rollback.
* Update check 10 seconds after startup and then every 6 hours while running.

Implemented in the connected Supabase project:
* Per-device user assignments and owner/admin/client roles.
* Roaming profile settings and Google profile fields.
* Device control state and richer heartbeat fields.
* Controlled enrollment, pairing, heartbeat, role and command RPCs.
* Primary-owner protections and server-side role checks.
* Administrator audit log.
* JWT-protected admin-account-control Edge Function for active/suspended/blocked account state.
* Device commands produced when account state changes.
* Additional authorization hardening and foreign-key indexes.
